Chapter 607: Chapter 34: Return (End Of Time Travel, Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 607: Chapter 34: Return (End of Time Travel, Subscription Request)_2

No matter who it was, no one saw Lin Yuan standing in front of the tombstone, as if they were not in the same spatial layer.

Lin Yuan gazed at the cemetery; although he was not the true Longshan Yuan, after so many years together, he still felt some emotion.

“You have left, and a year later, it will be my time to leave as well,” Lin Yuan murmured, as a year later would mark the limit of his stay during this travel.

Unless Lin Yuan was willing to expend another ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force to descend into this world, it seemed there would be no possibility of coming back again.

“It’s time to prepare for the last arrangements,” Lin Yuan stood in front of the Longshan Fang Couple’s tombstone for a long while before he finally vanished silently.

…

...

Martial Realm.

Longshan City.

Although the Longshan Family in the Martial Realm had less than a hundred Martial Tao True Gods, the construction of Longshan City was extraordinarily luxurious, far surpassing that of another city, Myriad Phenomena City.

The first member of the Longshan Family to become a Martial Tao True God was named Longshan Quan. As for Longshan Ling and his subordinates from the past, none had ignited the divine fire to this day.

Although they were not yet dead from old age, they would not live many more years, currently spending their twilight years peacefully on earth.

The numerous Martial Tao True Gods of the Longshan Family in the Martial Realm were all led by Longshan Quan, after all, as the first deity from their family, his influence was profound.

Longshan Great Hall.

Longshan Quan and a few other Martial Tao True Gods of the Longshan Family gathered for an exchange.

“The Ancestor is so benevolent, to have given outsiders so many opportunities,” Longshan Quan expressed discontent. Over the years, his disdain for the Martial Spirits of Myriad Phenomena City had only grown.

The Martial Realm, opened up by the forebears of their Longshan Family, should have remained their family’s private domain, yet it ended up housing a horde of outsiders like invasive species.

The other Martial Tao True Gods also nodded continuously. They had long regarded the entire Martial Realm as their backyard; how could those Martial Tao True Gods from Myriad Phenomena City deserve to live in the same place as them?

Suddenly.

Just then.

A figure appeared silently at one side.

“Ancestor.”

“Longshan Ancestor.”

Upon seeing this, Longshan Quan and the other True Gods of the Longshan Family immediately called out respectfully.

“Ancestor, you have finally agreed to see us,” Longshan Quan said excitedly.

Since ascending to the Martial Realm a hundred years ago, he had seen Lin Yuan only once, and despite several attempts to visit afterwards, he had received little response.

Lin Yuan, with a serene gaze, looked towards the Longshan Great Hall, towards the entire Longshan City, and spoke indifferently, “The Longshan Family thrived because of me; I do not wish for it to decline because of me.”

“Ancestor, how could the Longshan Family possibly decline because of you? Your strength is historically unparalleled, having opened up the Martial Realm and welcomed Martial Tao True Gods. The reverence the mortal beings have for you even surpasses the gods…”

Longshan Quan said somewhat puzzled.

As long as Lin Yuan was around, the status of the Longshan Family was undisputed; this had already become an ironclad rule.

“But I, too, will leave,” Lin Yuan continued.

“Leave?” Longshan Quan looked somewhat stunned, “Ancestor, where are you going, and when will you come back?”

The other Martial Tao True Gods looked at each other, their expressions somewhat perplexed.

“I won’t be coming back,” Lin Yuan said softly.

“Not coming back?” Longshan Quan was greatly alarmed. Lin Yuan was as significant to the Longshan Family as the sky itself, and also to this world.

If Lin Yuan were to suddenly disappear, Longshan Quan dared not imagine the commotion it would cause.

The blow it would deal to the Longshan Family would be fatal.

“Yes, not coming back,” Lin Yuan looked at the few Martial Tao True Gods of the Longshan Family, “Therefore, in the future, the Longshan Family must not be too harsh towards foreign True Gods.”

Although Lin Yuan always cared only about the spread of Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, and never particularly cared about the rise and fall of the Longshan Family, he still felt compelled to offer a few reminders before leaving.

“Ancestor…” Longshan Quan’s face turned ashen, desperately pleading as he looked at Lin Yuan.

He realized that what Lin Yuan was saying might indeed be true, and that the Longshan Family might soon lose its strongest support.

“Since I am leaving, I will also leave behind something,” Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and three crystals emitting a profound aura hovered.

“What is this?”

Longshan Quan was stunned, then his body began to tremble uncontrollably.

True God Form.

This was the True God Form.

Since Lin Yuan had slain twenty-four Prime Gods, the twenty-four True God Forms had not appeared again.

But even with a longing for the True God Form, no one dared to search for them, needless to say, all twenty-four True God Forms were in the hands of the leader of the Longshan Family.

“These three True God Forms, I will leave with the Longshan Family until you reach the Peak of Upper-Rank Gods, then you may attempt to Refine them.”

Lin Yuan said.

The twenty-four True God Forms had all been comprehended by Lin Yuan, and keeping them further held no significance.

Moreover, the True God Form is the essential ‘key’ to the rules of this World, and once it leaves this world, it will automatically collapse and, at the same time, will recondense into a new True God Form somewhere within the world.

Thus…

Before returning to the Main World, Lin Yuan naturally had to arrange the whereabouts of the True God Form.

“With these three Divine Lattices, even if I leave, the Longshan Family can thrive gloriously for a million or even more years.”

Lin Yuan looked at an excited Longshan Quan.

With these three True God Forms, the future of the Longshan Family is equivalent to having three True God-level powerhouses presiding over it.

This kind of foundation, unless another Lin Yuan comes along, thinking about shaking the foundation of the Longshan Family is absolutely difficult.

As long as the Longshan Family does not doom themselves and remains cautious and humble hereafter, their glory will not diminish much.

“Thank you, Ancestor.”

“Thank you, Ancestor.”

Longshan Quan immediately knelt down, and the other Martial Tao True Gods did the same.

“As for the remaining twenty-one True God Forms, I will release one every once in a while for other Martial Tao True Gods to vie for.”

“These Divine Lattices, the Longshan Family need not interfere.”

Lin Yuan continued.

He did not plan to place all twenty-four True God Forms with the Longshan Family, as this would have made their status unassailable, forming a monopolistic situation in this world for Martial Dao Cultivators.

And this is not conducive to the development of Martial Tao.

To truly advance Martial Tao, a brilliance of a myriad of schools is necessary. If the Longshan Family becomes too powerful, coupled with no restrictions from Lin Yuan, it would inevitably suppress other Martial Tao talents outside their family.

“Yes.”

Although Longshan Quan and the other Martial Tao True Gods were somewhat reluctant, since the Ancestor had made such a decision, they had no grounds to refuse.

“Ancestor…” Longshan Quan was about to speak.

But then realized that he was now alone.

Only leaving behind three True God Forms quietly floating there.

“The Ancestor has left…” Longshan Quan was momentarily dazed.

“The Ancestor is too kind.” The other Martial Tao True Gods looked at the three True God Forms with longing but dared not harbor any thoughts of seizing them.

Who knew if the Ancestor was still observing them in secret.

“Yes, the Ancestor is kind.” Longshan Quan sighed, “But since the Ancestor has already decided, my Longshan Family will follow the Ancestor’s words from now on, restrain our people, and completely give up the claim for the other True God Forms.”

“Yes.”

The several Martial Tao True Gods of the Longshan Family looked at each other and nodded in agreement.

…

In the depths of the multiple Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Everything that needed to be done has been done.” Lin Yuan looked downward, his gaze sweeping over the Martial Realm, Ocean of Light, dark abyss, and the realm of humans.

“Now, it’s time to return to the Origin Source.”

Next to Lin Yuan, two figures appeared, precisely the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit.

At the same time.

The ‘Bell-shaped’ Origin Fine Gold also floated in front of him, slowly oscillating with an inexplicable aura radiating from it.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit and Taiyin Primordial Spirit began to dissolve into the most pure energy, assimilating into the Origin Fine Gold, and Lin Yuan’s true physical body did the same.

If the true body and the two great Divine Spirits are too powerful, their dissolution, even if it begins, is extremely slow.

One year later.

As the inner worldly energies of the Physical Soul finally meld into the Origin Fine Gold for the last time, the Door to the Myriad Realms projection within Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will suddenly began to burst forth with light.

“Returning now.”

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will surged into the Door to the Myriad Realms, disappearing from this world.
